fusions.name: Shared Carcass
fusions.desc: The pack tears in, which deals 8 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, and you heal for 25% of the damage dealt. Holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Down to the Gristle
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 18 damage to the first enemy it meets, uses up every affliction you have on it for 50% more damage each, and heals you for 40% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Room at the Kill
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 4 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Bolted Meat
fusions.desc: Each time you kill an enemy, 20% of the damage you deal heals you for 6 seconds. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies. Once every 18 seconds.
